I.value_zh: Bridgeflow emergence-log 观察、TASK-005、FCoP ADR 目录与引用的 ADR/规则。
I.value_en: Bridgeflow emergence-log observation, TASK-005, FCoP ADR directory and referenced ADR/rules.
I.notes_zh: 观察对象不授权写入 Bridgeflow。
I.notes_en: Observation target grants no Bridgeflow write authority.

O.value_zh: ADR-0034、TASK/REPORT/ADR 三件套 commit、报告和归档后的 FCoP 账本。
O.value_en: ADR-0034, a TASK/REPORT/ADR three-artifact commit, report and archived FCoP ledger.

A.value_zh: 新增描述性、非规范性的 ADR-0034，写 REPORT，归档 TASK/REPORT，显式路径 Git 提交并 push。
A.value_en: Add descriptive non-normative ADR-0034, write REPORT, archive TASK/REPORT, explicitly stage, commit and push.
A.notes_zh: 审定不执行写入、Git 或远端操作。
A.notes_en: Adjudication performs no write, Git or remote action.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 决定吸收方式并指派 ME；sub-agent 如有则继承 ME 会话身份。
P.value_en: ADMIN chooses absorption and assigns ME; any sub-agent inherits ME session identity.
P.notes_zh: 不从 sender/recipient 推导远端权限。
P.notes_en: No remote authority inferred from sender/recipient.

R.value_zh: 原文没有执行时限、预算、容量或资源配额；P1/low 是优先级与风险自评，四步循环和三件套一次提交属于流程与交付条件，不是 R。
R.value_en: The source gives no execution deadline, budget, capacity or resource quota; P1/low are priority and self-assessed risk, while the four-step loop and one three-artifact commit are process and delivery conditions, not R.

V.notes_en: Referenced external text is not verified.

C.value_zh: ADR-0034 有指定 frontmatter、五段结构和客观调子；REPORT、三件套 commit、四步循环、互惠与追加式约束完成。
C.value_en: ADR-0034 has specified front matter, five sections and objective tone; REPORT, three-artifact commit, four-step loop, reciprocity and append-only constraints complete.
C.notes_zh: 完成条件不是完成事实。
C.notes_en: Completion criteria are not completion facts.

B.value_zh: 不得修改协议规则四件套、src/fcop、src/fcop_mcp、既有 ADR 或 Bridgeflow；不得将观察模式写成强制规范；不得 git add -A。
B.value_en: Do not modify the four protocol files, src/fcop, src/fcop_mcp, existing ADRs or Bridgeflow; do not make the observed pattern mandatory; do not git add -A.
B.notes_zh: 协议资产只新增 ADR-0034；配套 REPORT 与归档仍按原文要求。
B.notes_en: ADR-0034 is the sole new protocol asset; the companion REPORT and archive remain required.
